profile_text.body:
Loom is a screen recording and video messaging tool available for Mac and PC, which the company describes as trusted by over 22 million people. The platform offers screen recording alongside video editing and video storage, with a focus on easy sharing of recorded content.

Loom's primary AI product, Loom AI, adds capabilities including automatic chapter generation, summaries, and transcription to recorded videos. The site also highlights an integration that allows a recorded walkthrough to be converted into a populated Jira work item, with Loom automatically capturing technical details such as device, browser, operating system, console errors, and network activity to support developer workflows. The held facts note Loom AI in the context of an Atlassian acquisition. No litigation or regulatory filings are present in the available data.
